investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An Azure NSG in production (rg-baltic-prod-connectivity) was modified to add a rule allowing inbound TCP traffic on port 3389 from any source. The change originated from 194.126.101.99 in Tallinn, Estonia, associated with Marcus Webb. The requested rule appears labeled as a temporary access for review, but the action targets a production NSG and temporarily broadens remote access (RDP), increasing exposure risk. The actor's role in the alert payload differs from the user profile result, prompting heightened scrutiny.
investigation_notes.Rule Change Details: Inbound RDP rule (port 3389) allowed from any to any; rule name Test; priority 110; described as temporary for review
